candidates.title: Lazy top-level exports are invisible to type checkers and IDEs (module __getattr__ -> object, no TYPE_CHECKING imports)
evidence: dattri_llm/__init__.py:40-57 — 14 advertised names (all attributors, AttributionArguments, AttributionTask, AttributionScore, GradientStreamer, DiskGradientSource) exist only as strings in _LAZY_EXPORTS

This follows PEP 562 lazy-loading practice (for example scientific-python lazy_loader's stub approach).
